description: Provision a Google Cloud Bigqueryanalyticshub BigQueryAnalyticsHubDataExchange via Config Connector. Fields mirror the bigqueryanalyticshub.cnrm.cloud.google.com/v1beta1 BigQueryAnalyticsHubDataExchange spec.

description.description: Optional. Description of the data exchange. The description must not contain Unicode non-characters as well as C0 and C1 control codes except tabs (HT), new lines (LF), carriage returns (CR), and page breaks (FF). Default value is an empty string. Max length: 2000 bytes.

discoveryType.description: Optional. Type of discovery on the discovery page for all the listings under this exchange. Updating this field also updates (overwrites) the discovery_type field for all the listings under this exchange.

displayName.description: Required. Human-readable display name of the data exchange. The display name must contain only Unicode letters, numbers (0-9), underscores (_), dashes (-), spaces ( ), ampersands (&) and must not start or end with spaces. Default value is an empty string. Max length: 63 bytes.

documentation.description: Optional. Documentation describing the data exchange.

location.description: Immutable. The name of the location this data exchange.

primaryContact.description: Optional. Email or URL of the primary point of contact of the data exchange. Max Length: 1000 bytes.

projectId.description: GCP project ID for this resource. Rendered as the cnrm.cloud.google.com/project-id annotation. Leave empty to inherit the project from the namespace (Config Connector falls back to the namespace's project-id annotation, then to the namespace name). Leave empty when this resource's spec already carries a projectRef.
projectId.title: GCP project ID

projectRef.description: The project that this resource belongs to. Set exactly one of `external` (the resource's GCP URI or ID) or `name` (plus optional `namespace`) referencing another Config Connector resource in the cluster.

external.description: The `projectID` field of a project, when not managed by Config Connector.

kind.description: The kind of the Project resource; optional but must be `Project` if provided.

resourceID.description: Immutable. The BigQueryAnalyticsHubDataExchange name. If not given, the metadata.name will be used.

title: GCP Bigqueryanalyticshub BigQueryAnalyticsHubDataExchange
